text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did it! I went full throttle at a G1! My running just now was filled with red-hot passion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But this is far from my peak! I know I can
hit even
higher heights!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My dream is much, much hotter than
this!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Bamboo Memory seems to
have even
more energy than before the
race.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Racer A
text_block_list.text:
I can't give up. I've got to keep moving
forward,
just like her!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Racer B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'm gonna give it my all in my
next race,
the same way Bamboo
Memory did!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa... I wasn't expecting the race
to get so
heated without Oguri. So that's
Bamboo Memory,
huh... I'll have to keep
an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's the real deal when it comes to
sprints! This
year's Sprinters Stakes is
gonna be wild! I just
know it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That free-spirited way she runs has got
me
hooked! I can't wait to see her next
race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not only has she lit a fire under her
competitors
on the turf, but she also set
the hearts of the
audience ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And it seems... that same flame has
taken root in
my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So this is the real you, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After today's race, my confidence has
tripled!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go even higher, though! In fact, I
wanna
claim the very summit of sprints!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After knocking down one wall with a
stunning
performance, Bamboo Memory
is overflowing
with energy. It's hard to
believe she just finished a
whole race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please excuse the interruption.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to offer my congratulations,
Bamboo.
That was a spectacular race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan! Thanks so much for coming
today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, I should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There are some things we can only
convey
through running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Through your performance today, I was
able to
witness your dream, your desire,
and your
determination firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The pure and earnest light you shine
with has
inspired me to work toward my
own dream once
more.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for interrupting your
celebration. I
simply wanted to thank
you directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you and your dream,
Bamboo.
Now, if you'll excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She's totally feeling the heat! That
just
means I've gotta start burning even
brighter!
choice_data_list: “夢”が伝わったみたいで、よかったな
“夢”が伝わったみたいで、よかったね

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So what race should I do next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A mile race! Does that mean...
choice_data_list: 次はマイルのGⅠで力を試そう！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! That's where they decide the
Ruler of the
Mile in the first half of the
year! Yeah, what a
choice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna do even better at
the Yasuda
Kinen than I did today! And
then...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Honor and glory will be MINE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Bamboo Memory's truly
commendable job
at today's race, we set
our sights on our next
goal—the Yasuda
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There we go! The seats look clean to me!
I guess
that's everything for toda—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What the?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Chiyono O! That's right! She's set
the date
she's returning to racing, so she
must be back to
training full out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to watch her run again! And
she'll be
right there next to Ardan and
Yaeno and...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Chiyono O! I'm counting
down the
days until I see you race again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want to get in her way. I think
I'll head
over to the gym!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I knew it... I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's whisper is as soft as
it is
bitter. But those words don't reach
Bamboo
Memory's ears as she strides
confidently toward
the Yasuda Kinen.
